title: FlowContext
description: Flow context of a system flow (owner answer on INV-Q-9241, option B; INV-REQ-1202). A system flow is authorised once at its entry (API-25); the service that sends the call attaches this signed flow context so that the callee can bind it to row-level security. It travels in the HTTP header X-Flow-Context as a signed compact form (JWS compact serialization) whose payload holds these claims. The callee verifies the signature and the claims (the issuer of the signature is the open question INV-Q-9249 and is not decided here), refuses a call whose entity is outside the flow context, and logs the caller and the context per call. A context outside its lifetime (iat to exp, in seconds) or naming another tenant than the token is refused. The lifetime exp - iat is at most 900 seconds. entity.ref is present exactly when entity.kind is ENTITY: a flow such as createTenant has no entity and carries TENANT_WIDE. principalKind is the kind of the originating principal; a flow with no person is MACHINE (Inference). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41).

tenant.description: The tenant of the flow; it must equal the tenant of the token.

entity.description: The entity scope of the flow. kind ENTITY names one entity in ref; kind TENANT_WIDE has no ref.

kind.description: ENTITY: the flow is bound to one entity. TENANT_WIDE: the flow has no entity.

ref.description: The entity reference; present exactly when kind is ENTITY.

principalKind.description: The kind of the originating principal. A flow with no person is MACHINE (Inference).

callerService.description: The service that sends the call.

iat.description: Issued at, in seconds since the epoch.

exp.description: Expiry, in seconds since the epoch. exp - iat is at most 900.
